summary.text: John Cronin is a Democratic state senator who has represented the Worcester and Middlesex District since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He faces Ming Zhang, an unenrolled candidate, and is a U.S. Army veteran.

paragraphs.text: John J. Cronin was born in Leominster, Massachusetts.
He earned a degree from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point and served in the U.S. Army, reaching the rank of captain.
Cronin succeeded Dean Tran, a Republican, in the Massachusetts State Senate.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs both the Joint Committee on Emergency Preparedness and Management and the Public Safety and Homeland Security Joint Committee, is vice chair of the Health Care Financing Joint Committee, and sits on the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
